blind.description: A wooden funeral bier or stretcher on four turned legs. It features a recessed wooden slat surface bordered by raised wooden rails, four corner posts with rounded decorative tops/feet, and cylindrical carrying handles extending outwards from each corner post with red-accented rings near the joints. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with no hovering elements, melting, or fragmentation. It stands stably on its four carved legs without any added plinth or base.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden frame with extending carrying poles at top and bottom ends, enclosing three long parallel wooden planks making up the recessed bed.
blind.height_vs_figure: Height is about knee-height (around 1.5 ft / 0.25 the height of the figure), length is roughly 5.5 to 6 ft (close to the figure's total height), and width is roughly 2 to 2.5 ft.

match.reads_as: funeral bier / wooden stand with carrying handles
